scope: Predicted warehouse appearance from verified catalog sources and fit-group appearance transform; never raw gameplay evidence, never self-confirming identity, never solver-eligible by itself.

fitGroup.priorOutcome: 23 annotated physical items, 21 previous automatic exact confirmations, 2 unresolved; fit subset uses independently visually checked pair IDs within those prior confirmations.
fitGroup.method: median foreground occupancy, no per-item fitting; shape-specific only at n>=2

pairs.pairAuthority: independent visually checked ground truth ID + hash-verified catalog source and gameplay crop
